schema.name: orders
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  reference        TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
  registration_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES registrations(id),
  programme_slug   TEXT NOT NULL,
  plan             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (plan IN ('full', 'parts')),
  method           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('paystack', 'bank')),
  total_kobo       INTEGER NOT NULL,   -- what the learner owes in NGN, computed by the server
  regular_kobo     INTEGER NOT NULL,   -- the programme's regular price at the time
  hold_id          TEXT,               -- the price hold used, if any
  group_size       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  display_currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NGN',
  fx_rate          REAL,               -- units of display_currency per 1 NGN, when the order was made
  fx_at            TEXT,               -- when that rate was fetched
  status           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'part_paid', 'paid', 'cancelled'))
, residence_country TEXT, ip_country TEXT, pricing_tier TEXT, tuition_currency TEXT, tuition_minor INTEGER, charge_currency TEXT, pricing_snapshot TEXT, idempotency_key TEXT, request_fingerprint TEXT, payment_init TEXT)

schema.name: users
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  email          TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  role           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('student', 'instructor', 'admin')),
  status         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended')),
  full_name      TEXT NOT NULL,
  phone          TEXT,
  bio            TEXT,
  photo_key      TEXT,                -- R2 object key
  student_no     TEXT UNIQUE,         -- students only, e.g. SMA26-7KQ2M
  specialization TEXT,                -- instructors
  qualifications TEXT,                -- instructors: JSON array of strings
  links          TEXT,                -- instructors: JSON object {linkedin, portfolio, ...}
  registration_id TEXT,               -- the website registration this account came from, if any
  created_at     TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_login_at  TEXT
, verification TEXT, verification_checks TEXT, highest_qualification TEXT, experience TEXT, public_profile INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, staff_no TEXT, email_prefs TEXT, headline TEXT, achievements TEXT, certifications TEXT, languages TEXT, country_origin TEXT, country_residence TEXT, profile_submitted_at TEXT, verified_at TEXT, meet_link TEXT, guardian_name TEXT, guardian_relationship TEXT, guardian_email TEXT, guardian_phone TEXT, guardian_contact_ok INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, guardian_contact_note TEXT, admin_role TEXT
  CHECK (admin_role IS NULL OR admin_role IN ('super', 'admissions', 'finance', 'academic', 'faculty', 'support', 'reporting')), removed_at TEXT, removed_by TEXT, removal_reason TEXT, mfa_required INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

schema.name: audit_log_min_retention
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_min_retention BEFORE DELETE ON audit_log
WHEN OLD.at > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now', '-365 days')
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit entries younger than 365 days cannot be deleted');
END
